about: docs/data.md. `valid`: a view that must check. `refusals`: a view and the rule tag that refuses it. A case has `decl` (the data declarations, default one for x.json), `view` and `state`; `{sha:name}` and `{SHA:name}` in a decl are the SHA-256 of the corpus file `name`, in lower and in upper case. `files` are written beside the program: a text, `hex` bytes, `fill`, `gen` items, `nest` levels or `huge`. Checked by crates/cancho-ui/tests/data.rs.

valid.name: a list of names
valid.view: For { over: data.items(X, "items") as: p Text { "{json.get(p, \"name\", \"\")}" } }

valid.name: a link, a chip and an If from the items
valid.view: For { over: data.items(X, "items") as: p Rich { Link { to: json.get(p, "url", "") "{json.get(p, \"name\", \"\")}" } " " If { when: json.get(p, "stage", "") == "built" Chip { tone: "accent" "built" } } If { when: json.get(p, "stage", "") != "built" Chip { tone: "warn" "{json.get(p, \"stage\", \"\")}" } } } }

valid.name: a nested For over a list inside an item
valid.view: For { over: data.items(X, "items") as: p For { over: json.items(p, "tags") as: t Text { "{t}" } } }

valid.name: a join with filter
valid.view: For { over: data.items(X, "items") as: p For { over: filter(data.items(X, "items"), q => json.get(q, "name", "") == json.get(p, "name", "")) as: q Text { "{json.get(q, \"url\", \"\")}" } } }

valid.name: a CountUp and a Waffle from the items
valid.view: For { over: data.items(X, "items") as: p Rich { CountUp { to: num(json.get(p, "n", "0"), 0) } } Waffle { label: json.get(p, "name", "") of: num(json.get(p, "n", "0"), 0) counted: 1 columns: 2 } }
